name: apple-safari
description: Inspect and safely control Safari tabs, navigation, and Reading List on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and safely control Safari browsing state.
interface.longDescription: Inspect scoped tabs and page text, open or navigate reviewed URLs, close resolved tabs, and add Reading List items through macOS AppleScript with strict session privacy and JavaScript controls.
defaultPrompt: Use $apple-safari to summarize my current tab without exposing other tabs.
